text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Wednesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas delivered his annual address to parliament on Tuesday. He said that it was not an exaggeration to say that the hardest times for Lithuania were over.
- A fire in a village killed six people after a drinking bout.
- Arvydas Ilginis was elected the director general of Lithuanian National television and radio on Tuesday.
- Albinas Pilipauskas, 36, was appointed spokesman for Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius.
- Lithuanian government will subsidise the export of surplus beef.
- Lithuanian parliament appointed Dalia Skuodyte the director general of the Lithuania's Genocide and Resistance Centre.
- Deputy finance minister Rimas Survila was elected as chairman of the council of Lithuania's Savings Bank.
- The capitalisation of the stock exchange went down by 652 million litas last week.
- Interior Minister Vidmantas Zhiemelis suggested to Brazauskas the formation of a new body to coordinate crime prevention.
- The newspaper publishes an investigative article about the bancruptcy of Vakaru Bank.
